Name: Zero from The Nightmare Before Christmas
Author: JamieDepledge
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla dog sprite with Zero, the cute ghost dog from The Nightmare Before Christmas. I am not endorsed by Disney or anyone connected with The Nightmare Before Christmas. Any requests to take down the mod will be taken seriously.

How to install.
1. Backup your dog.xnb file that already exists in your \Stardew Valley\Content\Animals folder.
2. Download the file and unzip it.
3. Replace your old dog.xnb with the new one.
